tasks.short: Write or review specs for HR reports and dashboards: sources, measures, filters, access, refresh.

steps.what: Collect the report request and clarify the need with the requester
Look up source tables, fields and existing measures in AFAS extract and Power BI
Write the spec: measures, DAX definitions, filters, row-level security, refresh

loop.input: requirement notes, data dictionary, metric catalogue, spec template
loop.output: filled spec sections with measure definitions and DAX
loop.check: every table, column and measure named is matched against the data dictionary; unknown names are flagged, not written
loop.stop: one draft plus one repair pass per section; unresolved sections left marked for the analyst
loop.why_not_simpler: requirement notes are free text from HRBPs and managers; a template alone cannot turn them into measure definitions

steps.what: Review a built report or vendor spec against the agreed spec
Sign off with requester, including privacy check and minimum group size

tasks.design: A request form (Microsoft Forms into a SharePoint list) replaces the mail intake. A scheduled Python job reads Power BI model metadata and the AFAS extract schema into a data dictionary and metric catalogue; a bounded model step fills the SharePoint spec template from the request and dictionary, and a deterministic checker compares the deployed Power BI model against the spec and lists deviations.
tasks.previous_blocker: Specs need free-text requests turned into exact measure definitions, and nobody had time to build a metadata extractor for a one-person analytics function.
tasks.enabler_now: Models can draft measure definitions and DAX from plain requests, and AI coding makes a metadata extractor and diff checker a few days of work.
tasks.still_hard: Agreeing what a metric means (for example when the 90-day clock starts for a flex worker who converts) stays a negotiation between HR and Finance; models also invent column names, so the dictionary check is not optional.
tasks.human_edge: Deciding the definition, who may see which rows, and whether a group is too small to show without exposing individuals.

ambition.what: A published HR metric catalogue (90-day retention, verzuim rate, time to hire) that HRBPs, FP&A and Copilot read from

tasks.altitude: The analyst spends spec time on definitions and sign-off instead of typing; they gain the right to approve or refuse any new HR measure entering the semantic model.

reach.task: Defining headcount and personnel cost measures in finance Power BI reports
reach.learn: How Finance counts FTE and flex cost, so HR and Finance headcount numbers match at month close

evidence.claim: Copilot in Power BI writes DAX and summarises reports on a semantic model, but can misinterpret data without a prepared model and needs Fabric F2+ or Premium capacity
Text-to-SQL cut query writing from about 10 to 3 minutes, but hallucinated tables and columns remain unsolved
Power BI model metadata can be read through its APIs for a data dictionary

assumptions: Specs are written in Word on SharePoint from a template or could be
Noordhaven has an approved model service (Microsoft Copilot or Azure OpenAI) under its Microsoft 365 tenant
Spec drafting uses metadata only, no employee rows
unknowns: How many report specs are written or reviewed per year
Whether Noordhaven has Fabric or Premium capacity
Whether Power BI admin API access can be granted to the analyst
Whether external parties build HR reports that need spec review
research_questions: Of the last ten HR report specs, how much time went to writing versus agreeing definitions?
Does a drafted spec from the dictionary pass the analyst's review with under 30 minutes of edits on three real requests?
Can the AFAS extract schema and Power BI metadata be read automatically under current IT policy?

tasks.short: Scan HR tech and analytics trends and advise which tools or features Noordhaven should adopt or improve.

steps.what: Collect release notes, newsletters and regulator updates
Read items and filter for relevance to Noordhaven systems and HR

loop.input: one source item and a fixed list of Noordhaven systems, value streams and legal themes
loop.output: relevance label, three-line summary, source link, caveat
loop.check: summary must quote the source; items without a working link or with no matching theme are dropped
loop.stop: one pass per item, item cap per week; unclear items go to the analyst unlabelled
loop.why_not_simpler: release notes and articles are free text; keyword filters miss most relevant items and pass many irrelevant ones

steps.what: Check internal use: report views, open requests, licences in use
Judge fit, cost and legal limits: AVG, works council, AI Act
Write and present the brief to the HR Director

loop.output: two-page brief with sources and caveats
loop.check: every claim links to a shortlisted source; analyst edits before sending
loop.stop: one draft, one revision; else the analyst writes it
loop.why_not_simpler: the brief is prose that summarises judgement; a fixed template cannot write it

tasks.design: A weekly Python job pulls release notes from AFAS, Recruitee, Studytube and Power BI plus AP, AWVN and AI Act sources into a SharePoint list; a bounded model step labels and summarises each item with its link and caveat. A Power BI usage report sits next to it, and the analyst turns the shortlist into a quarterly brief that a model drafts and they edit.
tasks.previous_blocker: Reading dozens of sources a month for a 13-person HR team never paid off, so it happened ad hoc and from memory.
tasks.enabler_now: Models can label and summarise free-text release notes cheaply with source links, and feed collection is quick to build with AI coding.
tasks.still_hard: Vendor claims are rarely backed by customer results, and trend reports do not show cause; judging what holds for Dutch shift work under a CAO and works council stays with the analyst.
tasks.human_edge: Judging whether a feature fits Noordhaven's sites, data and works council, and saying 'not yet' to the HR Director with reasons.

ambition.what: An adopt, wait or drop call on each AFAS, Recruitee, Studytube and Power BI release every quarter instead of at the yearly contract renewal

tasks.altitude: Scanning shrinks to a weekly 30-minute review; the analyst becomes the named advisor on the HR system roadmap and proposes pilots to the HR Director.

reach.task: Tracking Studytube features and mandatory certificate options
reach.learn: Which learning features shorten onboarding in week one, so trend calls tie to the North Star

evidence.claim: Trend scans fit a model summary step with sources and caveats, external contacts stay human
Workday's own trend data does not establish how much of a decline AI caused, so caveats must be kept
48% of surveyed US employees exaggerated their AI use, so adoption surveys run high
Outside agents can reach Workday HR data through MCP tools since 13 Oct 2026, with no customer result published
From 2 Dec 2027 AI that allocates tasks or evaluates performance is high-risk, with oversight and logging duties

assumptions: The task in this company means HR tech and analytics trends, not product markets
Sources are public and need no personal data
The HR Director wants a regular brief
unknowns: Whether HR leadership reads or acts on a trend brief today
Which vendor channels AFAS, Recruitee and Studytube publish release notes on
Whether IT allows an approved model service for this use
research_questions: How many tool or feature decisions did HR make last year, and how many came from a trend scan?
Do model labels match the analyst's relevance call on 50 past items in at least four of five cases?
Would the HR Director use a quarterly adopt, wait or drop list in budget talks?

role.altitude: From producing reports and specs to owning the HR metric layer: definitions, the data dictionary, access rules, minimum group sizes and checks that managers, Finance and Copilot read from.
reach: FP&A Analyst: align headcount and personnel cost measures
Learning and Development Specialist: link certificates and onboarding data to 90-day retention
HR Business Partner: turn manager questions into verified answers on the semantic model
skills_to_grow: Semantic model design and row-level security in Power BI
Writing and testing bounded model steps with checks against metadata
AVG, WOR 27 and EU AI Act reading for HR analytics
Facilitating metric definition agreements between HR and Finance
role.ambitious_version: The analyst runs a governed HR metric catalogue and verified-answer layer so HRBPs and site managers get correct 90-day retention and verzuim figures by day 2 without asking, and the analyst's time moves to definitions, works-council-approved access and quarterly HR system roadmap calls.
